messages:
clara (docs): Hey team, I'm opening a concise PR to tighten up our Regions page: add deployment-mode columns, endpoint hosts, KMS support, and a short data-locality FAQ. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 :memo:
das (eng): Thanks. Can you include endpoint hosts (api.us.redwood.ai, api.eu.redwood.ai, api.ap.redwood.ai) and mark beta regions? ap-southeast-1 dedicated is still limited/beta.
clara (docs): Yep. Table plan: region | endpoint | hosted | dedicated | private (VPC/on-prem) | kms (hosted) | notes. Also adding a Python + Node SDK snippet for setting region and tenant header.
mina (security): Use "data locality" not "residency". Approved public string: "We may process or store customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." Paste verbatim. Also add DPA footnote for EU-DE.
rafa (product): Add a one-line migration checklist for hosted->dedicated: update base URL, rotate API keys, confirm IP allowlist, consider model pinning. Keep it short.
das (eng): KMS wrapping (hosted) available in us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS; Private depends on client setup. I'll paste a short infra snippet in the PR.
clara (docs): SDK snippets: Python example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(region=\"eu-west-1\", api_key=os.getenv(\"REDWOOD_KEY\"))
resp = client.text.generate(\"Hello\")
```
Node example:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood.Client({ region: 'ap-northeast-1', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const res = await client.text.generate('hi')
```
translate-bot: Note: for localized pages, translators ask for the exact legal string and context. I've flagged DE/FR/JA teams.
mina (security): Also include Sales contact template: "Customer requests contractual data locality in eu-west-1" so CS can copy/paste. Legal will review the email template in the PR.
rafa (product): Small product nit: link to /docs/performance for latency SLOs; don't hardcode numbers.
clara (docs): Good catch. I'll link to performance. Pushing branch in a few minutes. Please review inline if you have phrasing changes.
das (eng): I'll add the endpoint + KMS table rows in a follow-up commit if you want me to.
mina (security): I'll review the legal sentence and DPA footnote once the PR is up. Do not publish contractual guarantees publicly.
clara (docs): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921  CI queued. Tagging @das @mina @rafa for quick review. Marking thread resolved unless blockers come up. :white_check_mark:
